slides.headline: Andhra, South Odisha on Pre-Cyclone Watch; IMD Forecasts 145 KMPH Gusts

slides.stat_label: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Forecast at Sea
bullets: Cyclonic storm by 16 Nov, severe by 17 Nov
Track turns northwest towards Andhra Pradesh coast
No landfall point named yet; IMD says models diverge
slides.credit_line: Sources: IMD, The Hindu, Sambad English, Business Today

slides.stat_label: Extremely Heavy Rain Forecast for North Coastal Andhra
bullets: Expected at isolated places on 19-20 Nov
North TN, Puducherry: heavy to very heavy, 18-19 Nov
Odisha: heavy to very heavy rain, 19-21 Nov
slides.credit_line: Source: IMD National Bulletin No. 3, 15 Nov, 3 pm

slides.stat_label: Pre-Cyclone Watch Is IMD's First Warning Stage
bullets: Watch is issued 72 hours ahead of adverse weather
Cyclone alert follows at least 48 hours ahead
Cyclone warning, at least 24 hours ahead, names landfall
slides.credit_line: Source: IMD four-stage cyclone warning system
